# Roundabout (Carousel V06) — Tasks & Design Notes

## Overview

Recreation of ColorLib Carousel V06 as **Roundabout**, a clean, modern multi-item carousel showcase template.

## Section Structure (1:1 with Reference)

1. **Header / Navbar**: Brand logo ("Roundabout"), navigation links (Home, Features, Showcase, Pricing, Contact), and CTA button ("Get Started").
2. **Hero Carousel Section**: Large interactive multi-slide carousel featuring cards with background imagery, prominent headlines, descriptions, and Explore buttons.
3. **Features Grid Section**: 3-column feature highlights showcasing interactive navigation, performance, and responsiveness.
4. **Testimonials / Stats Section**: Social proof and metrics highlighting user satisfaction.
5. **Footer**: Links, copyright, and mandatory Component Dock attribution (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Design Notes & Tokens

- **Palette**: Slate neutrals (`#0f172a`, `#f8fafc`) paired with vibrant blue (`#3b82f6`) accents.
- **Typography**: Clean sans-serif with strong typographic hierarchy.
- **Images**: Uses deterministic Unsplash Picsum seed URLs (`https://picsum.photos/seed/roundabout-<n>/800/600`).
